In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our ADM methodology and associated tools have been proven to be very effective and practical for the accelerated development of telecommunications software.

the ADM methodology and its supporting tools can be used to improve software development productivity by a factor of 3 to 10, depending on the size of the project and the experience of the project team.
we have successfully demonstrated that the ADM methodology and the SDL tools can be used in a pragmatic manner to accelerate development of telecommunications software.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ADM methodology and the tools we use to implement it, have helped us to reduce the time-to-market for new telecommunications software by a factor of 4-5, and to improve the quality of the software produced.

the use of our ADM methodology, based on the use of formal languages and tools, allows us to achieve the following benefits in the development process: (i) 50% reduction in the requirements engineering time, (ii) 40% reduction in the design time, (iii) 40% increase in test case generation, (iv) 40% improvement in the test coverage of the software.

we have been able to show the feasibility of using SDL and related formal languages for the specification and testing of telecommunications software, and have been able to integrate these languages with the most widely used CASE tools to yield significant improvements in the software engineering process, and hence, in time-to-market.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a pragmatic methodology based on the use of SDL tools and techniques can significantly accelerate software development and improve time-to market.

formal methods can be used to accelerate software development and to increase software quality, and that this can be done with a pragmatic methodology that can be applied by software engineers who are not formal methods experts.

a pragmatic methodology based on a set of formal languages and tools can help overcome barriers to adoption of formal methods in software engineering and can help improve the time-to-market of telecommunications software.
